records.title: A Provable Energy-Guided Test-Time Defense Boosting Adversarial Robustness of Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: Robustness defense is a plausible VLM inference lineage, but primary full text could not be retrieved to establish the method’s inference cost or applicability.

records.title: MACRO: Advancing Multi-Reference Image Generation with Structured Long-Context Data
records.reason: Multi-reference image generation addresses long visual context, but is a generative data/model capability paper without a direct inference-efficiency result.

records.title: PAS3R: Pose-Adaptive Streaming 3D Reconstruction for Long Video Sequences
records.reason: Streaming 3D reconstruction maintains geometry across video but is not language-model inference or a relevant model-serving method.

records.title: A Review of Joint Optimization Methods for Neural Network Compression
records.reason: Review of neural-network compression is broad and does not establish a concrete LLM or transformer inference method.

records.title: Vmxdotp: A RISC-V Vector ISA Extension for Efficient Microscaling (MX) Format Acceleration
records.reason: RISC-V microscaling kernels show hardware throughput gains, but no LLM/model-level workload or end-to-end serving evaluation is demonstrated.
